title: Blackberry Crumble
description: A French-inspired dessert showcasing the sweetness of blackberries with a crunchy oat topping.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the blackberries, sugar, and flour.
Transfer the blackberry mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, combine the oats, cold butter, and a pinch of salt. Mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Spread the oat mixture evenly over the blackberry filling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg and a splash of cold water. Brush the egg wash over the oat topping.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy!
